def glomit(self, target, scope):
    scope[MODE] = GROUP
    scope[CUR_AGG] = None  # reset aggregation tripwire for sub-specs
    scope[ACC_TREE] = {}

    # Initialize the accumulator for the spec
    if type(self.spec) in (dict, list):
        _spec_id = id(self.spec)

        return scope[ACC_TREE][_spec_id]
